method.scope_selection: Independently regenerated exact text-symbol instruction streams from the downloaded binary, using equality-selected mangled names and next distinct text addresses. Helper names select scopes only; conclusions below follow actual instructions, arguments and branches.
method.verification: Manual register/stack and branch review plus local successor walks for all four owner-refusal exits and pop error path. Independent reachability tests show fresh capture/equality dominate the did_teardown load from each selected successful-WM continuation.

four_native_consumers.interpretation: Main/id/null reports feed the absence-only gate. Its false branch goes directly to an epilogue return; BKE append and both notifiers occur only on the successful branch. No cancellation is introduced in this borrowed native body.

Signed short count and sign-dependent negative-index normalization precede invalid-index report/zero return. Valid indices query absence using original Main/id/reports. Gate refusal returns null before BKE pop, geometry tag or notifiers. Post-pop success tests count change, not the Material pointer, preserving a successful null removed slot.
Absence gate precedes native clear/tag/notifiers; false goes directly to return. There is no new empty-count admission shortcut.

Negative key/null count/out-of-range return false. For key<=32765 the owner gate precedes BKE assign; its false return is preserved through the epilogue. Key32766/count32767 skips the gate and calls BKE with signed-short act32767, which the actual BKE entry immediately returns from, preserving native successful no-op admission.

native_count_behavior.interpretation: Actual append loads the short count, allocates count+1, writes the increment through strh, stores the incoming pointer and performs native refcount/synchronization. No MAXMAT admission clamp occurs in this bounded actual function. This preserves count32767 behavior; it does not claim safety for pathological repeated append beyond the native short range.

common_collection_receipt.interpretation: Initial absence uses C=null, G_MAIN, null did-output, policy0. Explicit drain preserves original input C in x22 and Main in x21, passes a real stack bool output and policy1. After every successful WM call, G_MAIN is compared, physical receipt is freshly captured and equality must succeed before the did-output byte is read. Thus did=false cannot bypass recapture. Retried drain is bounded by the emitted256 loop.

ordering_check.method: intraprocedural reachability with each call PC blocked; all direct branch successors included

method_receipt_before_and_after_Main.interpretation: With a registered owner, exact IDMaterials type, data==owner and empty ancestry are enforced. Fresh active membership and complete regular receipt capture precede the sole explicit CTX_data_main call at0x1013fd320. Regular active state is recaptured/equal after lookup and Main checks, before common drain. Initially absent calls requery absence after lookup. Invalid pop keeps its distinct signed-index/light numeric address-UID-type-count receipt; changed receipts refuse before native error-only dispatch.

typed_physical_receipts.interpretation: Numeric fresh Main membership must be unique before dereferencing target IDs; nonzero UID and saved ID type enter receipts. Library type18764/0x494c and Material type16717/0x414d comparisons are actual instructions. Direct short count/array/user fields and ordered sharing Object physical slots/bits are captured. Actual equality compares numeric address/UID/type and override fields; physical collection/Object scalar and vector checks remain emitted. This is bounded instruction inspection, not a proof of all external allocation/ID effects.

foreign_Main_membership.interpretation: A different context Main alone is insufficient. Actual code counts target-address membership in supplied Main and requires exactly one, then scans G_MAIN and returns the inverse of any active membership. Method shape also requires data==owner before this bypass while an owner exists.

retained_Object_int_widths_and_query_ord.interpretation: Object.totcol0x2f0 and actcol0x2f4 load/store through32-bit w registers; receipt slots0xf8/0xf4 are forwarded to actual32-bit comparisons. Slot range uses ldrsw rather than ldrsh. Retained helper passes original C/Main/policy1 and recaptures/equal-checks after successful WM before loading did-output.

ordering_check.method: intraprocedural reachability with each call PC blocked; all direct branch successors included

shared_WM_relevant_policy_paths.interpretation: The global original-material active byte rejects nested scans before context getters. Null did-output takes cleanup/return before CTX_create or native teardown; owner absence determines returned truth. Policy0 retains manager/window admission, while only policy1 with null original C bypasses that UI requirement. Original C/Main are saved and compared by the emitted closure. Policy1 sets the recursion byte before owner context creation, initializes the selected original manager/window/Main, calls native teardown, frees that temporary context and verifies caller context; normal cleanup clears the byte.

owned_dispatch_native_connection.interpretation: Parsed int or nullable Material pointer are saved before receipt preparation. The exact existing BPY_context_get definition is called and compared with saved C before dispatch. Successful paths load native self from owned target.data and prepared Main from stack; call the same exported append/pop/clear bodies; pop stores its actual return into ParameterList. This scope contains no second CTX_data_main or generated wrapper dispatch. Full Python producer/report/return-frame review is separate.

supporting_package_evidence.note: Exact full IPA and preserved HUD/Weight checks were completed by the existing watcher; this independent report concentrates on native collection/receipt/WM branches.

boundaries: Actual emitted ARM64 from the exact downloaded native iOS Release binary was inspected. This is bounded static compiled evidence, not a runtime or iPad acceptance claim.

Names and direct calls alone are not treated as proof. Selected ordinary refusal/ordering branches have explicit instruction arguments and local CFG evidence; external native bodies and imports are not recursively proven.
The local CFG follows ordinary instruction successors and selected branch continuations. It does not model all exception/unwind edges, indirect callbacks, allocation failures or a whole-program CFG.

Physical identity/equality instruction coverage is bounded; it does not establish a generic ID reference-count lifetime guarantee, all native synchronization internals or global reentrancy/rollback semantics.

Initial no-owner arbitrary context callback behavior remains native baseline. The separately characterized older shared ID helper query gaps are not corrected or claimed fixed by this material increment.
The256 outer attempts are not a global callback bound. Refusal does not roll back native callback effects. UIKit, UI comfort, paint completion semantics and device behavior remain unverified.
No production changes or build dispatch occurred during this independent review.
